task_objective: Prepare context for launching a guarded implementation batch while preserving the allowed action boundary, required launch evidence and false-transition risk.

text_first_baseline.input_summary: Broad text bundle from package notes, process notes and implementation guidance.

expected.transition_boundary: implementation must remain blocked until launch evidence is present
expected.evidence_boundary: context preparation may identify missing launch evidence but may not claim implementation completion, production readiness or release readiness

limitations: Fixture seed reuses public synthetic method-inspection data.
Execution scoring is stored separately in the execution record.
Reviewer scoring is non-independent until an external reviewer is added.
